name: livret-evaluation-monorepo
description: Application de livret d'évaluation — Electron + Angular + NestJS

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "wait-on http-get://localhost:4200/main.js && npm run start:electron"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && cd electron && npm run dist
